description: Top products in one category, most upvoted first, with featured (paid) products first and marked. Use it when a user asks for the best tools of a kind without a specific keyword. Each result has `pageUrl` (its page on CodeDebut: cite it as the source) and `website` (the product's own site).

category.description: Category slug from list_categories (developer-tools, ai, productivity, marketing, design, analytics); the category name also works.
